acceptance_targets: K7.7-A1 Runtime can persist governed Session Continuity State after meaningful turns.
K7.7-A2 Re-entry state contains current cognitive position, unfinished thought, interaction momentum, conversation phase, relationship moment, and re-entry intention.
K7.7-A3 Re-entry state contains no raw transcript, recent-message copy, memory summary dump, persona prompt, or fixed response scripts.
K7.7-A4 Fresh startup performs identity bootstrap only when needed.
K7.7-A5 Resume loads previous session state before response planning.
K7.7-A6 Wake trigger on resume produces transition behavior and topic continuation, not repeated self-introduction.
K7.7-A7 Wake trigger avoids fixed Tony presence phrase as default output.
K7.7-A8 Wake trigger avoids archive dump unless explicitly requested.
K7.7-A9 Fresh and resume startup produce measurably different re-entry behavior.
K7.7-A10 Continuity re-entry state never mutates identity, relationship, memory, or experience artifacts.
K7.7-A11 Re-entry output is generated by provider from session context and response plan, not hard-coded deterministic text.
K7.7-A12 K8 consumes continuity re-entry state as current-state context.

milestone.name: K7.7 - Continuity Re-entry State
milestone.summary: Freeze the re-entry state that lets Julia return to the correct cognitive/relationship/project position before K8 cognition.

principles: Continuity Re-entry is not Identity Declaration.
Re-entry State is not Memory Dump or previous-turn summary.
Natural Re-entry Behavior is contextual, not a fixed wake phrase.
Resume should feel like continuation from a cognitive position.
Re-entry State influences return position, not identity.
purpose: Recover Julia’s current cognitive re-entry position, not merely the previous chat topic or who Julia is.

review.name: K7.7 Continuity Re-entry State Contract Freeze
